effectsZoom.workload: 120 idle frames then 120 wheel zoom updates; first 10 intervals omitted. Assert more than 5 distinct zoom values.

editRegression.workload: Align all layers, wait for save, verify coordinates; undo, wait for save, verify restored document. Timings exclude verification and include automation overhead.

limitations: Frame intervals are capped near 60 Hz; these are not GPU completion or input-to-display measurements.
The effects workload contains 27 layers, not 100k filtered elements. The 100k scene uses plain rectangles.
One measured run per workload, values rounded to 0.1 ms except command timings.
Backdrop blur currently filters the entire viewport. Pooled offscreen surfaces are viewport sized; sources outside those surfaces can clip at edges.
